DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をなくされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯が見つかりません。位置の表示が家から離れた所に変わったので、探しに行く前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯が見つからず位置表示が家から離れた場所に変わったので、自分で探しに行く前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find my phone. Its location display has changed to somewhere away from home, so I'd like advice before going to look for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your phone is missing and its displayed location moved away from home, so you want advice before searching yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず状況を伺います。最後にご自身で携帯を持っていた場所と時刻はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, I'll ask about the situation. Do you know where and when you last personally had the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 買い物の後、車で18時10分に使いました。その後は見ていません。今開いた位置画面の更新時刻は、同じ日の16時40分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に車内で使ったのは18時10分で、位置画面は同日16時40分に更新されたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used it in the car at 18:10 after shopping. I haven't seen it since. The location screen I just opened was last updated at 16:40 that same day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you last used it in the car at 18:10 and the location screen was updated at 16:40 on the same day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示の更新は、最後に使った18時10分より1時間30分前ですね。今画面を開いた時刻とは違います。この表示を現在の場所としては記録せず、更新時刻付きの情報として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The display was updated an hour and thirty minutes before you last used it at 18:10. That's different from when you opened the screen now. We won't record this as its current location, but as information accompanied by the update time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面を今見たので、位置も今のものだと思っていました。表示の場所へ行くのはやめます。16時40分の画面を残し、最後に使った車の座席を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今見た画面を現在位置と思っていたと説明し、表示の場所へ行かず16時40分の画面を保存して車の座席を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Because I looked at the screen just now, I thought the location was current too. I won't go to the displayed location. I'll save the 16:40 screen and check the car seat where I last used it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the screen you just viewed for the current location, and say you will not go there but will save the 16:40 screen and check the car seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 安全に確認できる範囲で探してください。携帯の色、ケース、連絡先も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please search only where you can check safely. I'll also ask for the phone's color, case, and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 灰色の携帯に透明のケースです。紛失した電話では連絡を受けられないので、家族に許可をもらったこの番号を連絡先にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 灰色の携帯と透明ケースの特徴を示し、家族の許可を得た番号を代替連絡先として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's a gray phone with a clear case. I can't receive calls on the missing phone, so I'd like to use this number with my family's permission as the contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the gray phone and clear case, and give an alternative contact number authorized by your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族の許可がある別の連絡先ですね。灰色の携帯・透明ケース、最後の使用18時10分、画面更新16時40分を別々に記録しました。読み返した内容で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: An alternative contact with your family's permission, then. I've separately recorded a gray phone with a clear case, last use at 18:10, and screen update at 16:40. Is that readback correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、合っています。18時10分の使用と16時40分の更新は別ですね。家族の番号で連絡を受け、端末や回線の保護は契約先にも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 18時10分の使用と16時40分の位置更新を別々に記録したと確認し、家族の番号で連絡を受け契約先にも保護手続きを聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, that's correct. The use at 18:10 and update at 16:40 are separate. I'll receive contact at my family's number and also ask my provider about protecting the device and connection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the use at 18:10 and location update at 16:40 are recorded separately, and say you will use your family's number and ask the provider about protective procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その区別で記録しました。現在の場所はまだ確認できていません。連絡先は紛失した端末の番号と分けて残します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've recorded that distinction. Its current location is still unconfirmed. We'll keep the contact number separate from the missing device's number. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お届けについて、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about your delivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 再配達を頼みましたが、急に残業になりました。家にいられないので、受け取り方を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達を頼んだ後で急に残業が決まり在宅できなくなったので、受取り方を変えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I requested redelivery, but suddenly have to work overtime. I won't be home, so I'd like to change how I receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say unexpected overtime after requesting redelivery means you cannot be home, and you want to change the collection method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込済みの日時と、現在の案内を確認しましょう。完了の画面か控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the requested date and time and the current instructions. Do you have the completion screen or a record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この画面です。今日の夜を選びました。家族も外出しているので、そのままにするとまた不在になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込完了画面を示して今夜を選んだと伝え、家族も外出しているため変更しないと再び不在になると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the screen. I selected tonight. My family is out too, so if I leave it unchanged, no one will be home again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the completion screen for tonight and explain that your family is also out, so an unchanged delivery would again find nobody home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更できる方法を、不在票や申込の案内で確認してください。すでに配達の準備が進んでいる場合は、案内先への照会が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the notice or request instructions for ways to change it. If delivery preparations are already underway, you'll need to inquire with the indicated contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面で変更できないので、担当へ電話したいです。窓口受取に変える場合も、ここに荷物があると決めつけないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面で変更できないので担当者に電話したいと伝え、窓口受取りでも荷物がその場所にあるとは限らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can't change it on the screen, so I'd like to call the person in charge. Even if I change to counter collection, I shouldn't assume the parcel is here, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the screen does not allow a change so you want to call staff, and confirm counter collection does not necessarily mean the parcel is at that location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。保管先と受取条件を確認してから、窓口へお越しください。予定だけ変えれば荷物も自動で移るとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please check the storage location and collection conditions before visiting the counter. Changing the plan alone won't necessarily move the parcel automatically.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事場の近くへ寄れるので、別の局で受け取れたらと思いました。可能か、持参物と一緒に先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事場の近くの別の郵便局で受け取る希望を伝え、可能かどうかと必要な持参物を先に聞くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can stop near my workplace, so I was hoping to collect it at another post office. I'll first ask whether that's possible and what to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect at another post office near work and will first ask whether it is possible and what you need to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更先を希望する場合は、可否と手順を担当へ確認してください。保管期限も合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you'd like a different location, check whether it's possible and the procedure with the person in charge. Check the storage deadline too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の再配達に在宅できないと伝え、変更の可否を確認します。受取局と期限と必要書類がわかってから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日の再配達時に在宅できないことを伝えて変更可否を尋ね、受取局、保管期限、必要書類がわかってから移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain I can't be home for today's redelivery and check whether I can change it. I'll travel only after knowing the collection office, deadline, and required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will report being unable to be home for today's redelivery, ask whether changes are possible, and travel after confirming the office, storage deadline, and documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確定した案内に沿って受け取りをお願いします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please collect according to the confirmed instructions. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。カードについて、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about your card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日なくしたカードを止めましたが、財布が見つかりました。これでそのまま使っていいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日紛失して利用を止めたカードが財布と一緒に見つかったので、そのまま使ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I stopped the card I lost yesterday, but my wallet has been found. Can I use it again as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the card stopped after being lost yesterday was found with your wallet, and ask whether you may use it as it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停止したカードの種類と、受付した内容を確認しましょう。銀行のカードと、ほかの会社のカードは区別できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the type of card you stopped and what was requested. Can you distinguish the bank card from cards issued by other companies?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 財布には銀行のキャッシュカードと別のクレジットカードがあります。昨日電話で止めたのは、この銀行のカードです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 財布には銀行のキャッシュカードと他社のクレジットカードがあり、昨日電話で止めたのは銀行のカードだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My wallet contains a bank cash card and a separate credit card. The one I called to stop yesterday was this bank's card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your wallet contains a bank cash card and another company's credit card, and you called yesterday to stop the bank card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発見しても、そのまま利用できるとは限りません。停止後の手続きと再発行の状況を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Finding it doesn't necessarily mean you can use it immediately. We'll check post-suspension procedures and the reissue status with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 再発行の申込みまでしたかは覚えていません。新しいカードが来るなら、見つかった古いものを使わずに保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再発行まで申し込んだか覚えておらず、新しいカードが来る場合は見つかった古いカードを使わず保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't remember whether I applied for reissue as well. If a new card is coming, I'll keep the old one that was found without using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you do not remember applying for reissue and will keep the found old card unused if a new one is coming. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ申込状況を確認しましょう。本人確認のために必要なものもご案内します。別会社のカードはその会社へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's ask the person in charge about your application status. We'll also explain what is needed to verify your identity. Please check the other company's card with that company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: クレジットカードも停止したと思い込んでいました。銀行へ電話しただけなので、そちらは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: クレジットカードも止めたと思い込んでいたが銀行へ電話しただけなので、発行会社に別途確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I had assumed the credit card was stopped too. I only called the bank, so I'll check that separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed the credit card was stopped but only called the bank, so you will check separately with its issuer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、それぞれの停止と利用の状態を確認してください。ここで他社のカードが保護されているとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, check each card's suspension and use status. We can't determine here that another company's card is protected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行の停止と再発行の状況を先に聞きます。見つかったカードを試さず、クレジットカードは発行会社へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行の利用停止と再発行状況を先に聞き、見つかったカードを試さず、クレジットカードは発行会社に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first ask about the bank card's suspension and reissue status. I won't try using the found card, and I'll check the credit card with its issuer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will first check bank-card suspension and reissue, not test the found card, and ask the issuer about the credit card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。財布が見つかった場合も手続きの案内に従ってください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll put you in touch with the person in charge. Please follow the procedure instructions even after finding your wallet. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to discuss about a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った保存容器を交換できるか聞きたいです。家の棚に入らないのと、ふたに傷があるのが気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日買った保存容器が棚に入らずふたにも傷があるので、交換できるか相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to ask whether I can exchange the storage container I bought yesterday. It doesn't fit my shelf, and I'm concerned about a scratch on the lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say yesterday's storage container does not fit the shelf and has a scratched lid, and you want to ask whether exchange is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品とレシートを確認させてください。傷に気づいたのは、いつでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me check the product and receipt. When did you notice the scratch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱から出した時です。まだ食品は入れていません。大きさは私の測り間違いですが、傷とは別の問題として伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱から出した時に傷を見つけ、まだ食品を入れておらず、寸法の測り間違いと傷を別の問題として説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: When I took it out of the box. I haven't put food in it. The size was my measurement mistake, but I'd like to explain that separately from the scratch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found the scratch on unboxing, have not put food in it, and want to explain your measurement mistake and the scratch as separate issues. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: サイズのご希望と、購入時の状態の確認を分けて伺います。包装や付属品は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask about your preferred size separately from checking the condition at purchase. Do you still have the packaging and accessories?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱と説明書はあります。小さい容器に替えたいですが、傷の確認が済む前に交換が決まったと思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱と説明書が残っており小さい容器を希望するが、傷の確認前に交換が決まったとは考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the box and instructions. I'd like a smaller container, but won't assume an exchange is approved before the scratch is checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the box and instructions and prefer a smaller container, but will not assume exchange is decided before checking the scratch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。商品の状態と、店の対応条件を確認します。希望する別商品の大きさは確かめていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We'll check the product's condition and the store's response conditions. Have you checked the size of the alternative you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 棚の幅を測り直してきました。今回は箱の寸法だけでなく、ふたを含めた外側の幅も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棚の幅を測り直してきたので、箱の寸法だけでなくふたを含む容器の外寸も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've measured my shelf width again. This time I'd like to check the container's outside width including the lid, not only the box dimensions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have remeasured the shelf width and want to check the container's external size including the lid, not just the box dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補の商品にある寸法表示もご確認ください。交換の可否と、差額がある場合の扱いは確認後にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the dimension labels on the possible products too. After checking, we'll explain whether exchange is possible and how any price difference is handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートと未使用の状態と傷を示します。対応が可能なら、棚の幅に合う寸法を確認してから交換を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシート、未使用の状態、傷を示し、対応できる場合に棚の幅に合う寸法を確かめてから交換商品を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the receipt, unused condition, and scratch. If you can help, I'll check which size fits the shelf width before choosing an exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the receipt, unused condition, and scratch, and if a response is possible, check the shelf-fitting size before choosing a replacement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず商品の状態と対応条件を確認します。ご説明いただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll first check the product condition and response conditions. Thank you for explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 散歩中に岸の近くで大きい容器を見ました。自分で動かさず、担当へ知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 岸で容器を見つけたが触っていないので、担当者に報告したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw a large container near the shore while walking. I'd like to notify the person in charge without moving it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found a container at the shore but have not touched it, and want to report it to staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、安全な通路にいますか。見た位置を地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you on a safe path now? Can you show where you saw it on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通路にいます。案内図のこの辺りで、容器へ近づいてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 安全な通路から見た位置を案内図で示し、近づいていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm on the path. It was around here on the map, and I haven't gone near the container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show on the map where you saw it from the safe path and explain you have not approached. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その位置を担当へ伝えます。外からわかる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll give that location to the person in charge. Are there any features visible from outside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白い容器で文字がありますが読めません。中身を確かめるためにふたを開けることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器は白く、文字は読めないので、中身を確認するために開けたりしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a white container with writing, but I can't read it. I won't open the lid to check the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the container is white with unreadable writing and you will not open it to inspect the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見える範囲で構いません。写真を撮る場合も、危ない所へ近づかないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: What you can see is enough. Even if taking a photo, don't approach dangerous places.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路から撮った一枚があります。近くの人に拾ってもらうのではなく、担当へ写真と位置を渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路から撮った写真を担当者に見せ、ほかの人に拾うよう頼まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have one photo taken from the path. Rather than ask someone nearby to pick it up, I'd like to give the photo and location to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the photo taken from the path to staff and say you will not ask others to pick it up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置と写真で状況を確認します。現物は動かさずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the situation using the location and photo. Please wait without moving the container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 白い容器、読めない文字、通路からの写真を伝えます。自分で開けたり持ち帰ったりせず、担当に任せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器の特徴、写真、位置を報告し、開けたり持ち帰ったりせず対応を任せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report the white container, unreadable writing, and photo from the path. I won't open it or take it home; I'll leave it to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the container's features, photo, and location, and say you will leave the response to staff without opening it or taking it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お知らせありがとうございます。安全な場所を保ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for letting us know. Please stay somewhere safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符について、どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need with tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 船を予約したので、苫小牧からの列車もこの予約番号で乗れるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 船を予約したので、その予約番号で苫小牧からの列車にも乗れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've booked a ferry. I'd like to know whether this booking number lets me take a train from Tomakomai too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you booked a ferry and ask whether its booking number also allows you to board a train from Tomakomai. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の内容を確認しましょう。船の区間だけですか、それとも鉄道も含む案内がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the booking details. Is it only for the ferry section, or is there information including rail travel too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 船だけの予約でした。船の券があれば途中の列車も含まれると思っていました。列車の切符は別に買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約は船だけで列車も含まれると思っていたと説明し、列車の切符を別に購入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was only a ferry booking. I thought a ferry ticket included the train along the way too. I'd like to buy a separate train ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the booking is ferry-only though you thought rail travel was included, and say you want to buy the train ticket separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗る駅と降りる駅を確かめてから選びましょう。港の施設名と乗船受付の場所もわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the boarding and alighting stations before choosing. Do you also know the port facility name and boarding reception location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 施設の名前はありますが、受付の住所はまだ見ていません。同じ港ならどこでもよいと思わず、船会社の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 港の施設名はわかるが受付住所をまだ確認しておらず、同じ港ならどこでもよいとは考えず船会社の案内を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the facility name but haven't looked at the reception address yet. I won't assume anywhere in the same port will do; I'll check the ferry company's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you know the port facility name but have not checked the reception address, and will check the ferry company's information rather than assume anywhere in the port is suitable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その受付に着くまでの移動も含めて調べてください。列車の切符だけで港への移動が完了するとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please include the journey all the way to that reception when planning. A train ticket alone doesn't necessarily complete the journey to the port.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 船会社の案内に、受付の住所がありました。列車に乗る区間と、駅から先の交通を分けて調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 船会社の案内で受付住所がわかったので、列車の区間と駅から先の交通を分けて調べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I found the reception address in the ferry company's instructions. I'd like to look up the train section separately from transport beyond the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the ferry company's guidance gave the reception address, and you want to check the train section and onward transport separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。必要な区間が決まったら、券の種類と購入方法をご案内できます。乗船の受付期限も別にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Once the required section is established, we can explain ticket types and purchase methods. Please also separately check the ferry boarding check-in deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 船の券と列車の券を分け、受付住所までの経路を確かめます。乗船受付に余裕を持てる区間で切符を買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 船と列車の券を分けて受付住所までの経路を確かめ、乗船受付に余裕を持てる区間の切符を買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll separate the ferry ticket from the train ticket and check the route to the reception address. I'll buy a ticket for a section that leaves enough time for boarding check-in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will distinguish ferry and train tickets, check the route to the reception address, and buy a rail-section ticket allowing enough time for ferry check-in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。船会社と鉄道の案内をそれぞれ確かめてください。お気をつけてご旅行ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the ferry company's and railway's information separately. Have a safe trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。届いた書類について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about the documents you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この書類を返す期限が明日です。明日の夕方に郵便へ出せば、期限内になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返送期限が明日の書類について、明日の夕方に郵送すれば期限内になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The deadline for returning this document is tomorrow. If I post it tomorrow evening, will it be within the deadline?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether posting tomorrow evening meets tomorrow's document-return deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知に「消印有効」か「必着」かの記載はありますか。一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the notice say 'postmark accepted' or 'must arrive by'? Let's check together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに必着とあります。出した日で判断されると思っていました。明日届くかはまだ調べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知には必着と書かれているが投函日で判断されると思っており、明日届くかは調べていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says 'must arrive by' here. I thought it was judged by the posting date. I haven't checked whether it can arrive tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice says it must arrive by the deadline, but you thought the posting date counted and have not checked arrival tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着期限として確認が必要ですね。通知に、郵送以外の提出方法が載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll need to check it as an arrival deadline. Does the notice list any submission method other than post?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: オンラインの案内があります。でも画面で入力しただけで、添付書類も出したことになるかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: オンライン提出の案内はあるが、画面に入力すれば添付書類も提出したことになるかわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's online guidance. But I don't know whether just entering the information on the screen also counts as submitting the attachments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say online submission guidance exists but you do not know whether entering information also submits the supporting documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出方法ごとの必要事項を担当に確認しましょう。入力、添付、送信完了を分けて確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the requirements for each submission method with the person in charge. Check entering, attaching, and completed sending separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は入力を保存しただけです。送信していないので、受付番号もありません。添付の出し方と完了確認を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入力を保存しただけで未送信のため受付番号がないと説明し、添付の出し方と提出完了の確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So far, I've only saved the entries. I haven't sent them, so I don't have a receipt number. I'd like to ask how to submit attachments and confirm completion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only saved entries and have no receipt number because they are unsent, and ask how to submit attachments and verify completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状況で担当へおつなぎします。間に合わない可能性があれば、期限についても早めにご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll refer you with that status explained. If there is a chance you won't make it in time, please discuss the deadline promptly too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必着の期限を説明し、保存だけで未送信と伝えます。オンラインで出せる書類と完了の確認方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必着期限と入力保存のみで未送信の状況を説明し、オンラインで提出できる書類と完了確認方法を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the arrival deadline and that I've only saved, not submitted. I'll ask which documents can be submitted online and how to confirm completion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the arrival deadline and saved-but-unsent status, and ask which documents can be submitted online and how to confirm completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知を持って担当へご相談ください。ご確認ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the notice and consult the person in charge. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の受付で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you register for your medical visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右耳が聞こえにくくなりました。日本語の聞き取りも難しいので、友人と来ました。受付方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右耳が聞こえにくく日本語の聞き取りも難しいため友人と来たと伝え、受診の受付方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've developed difficulty hearing in my right ear. Understanding Japanese is difficult too, so I've come with a friend. Please tell me how to register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came with a friend because hearing in your right ear and understanding Japanese are difficult, and ask how to register for care. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状を医療スタッフへ伝えます。聞こえにくさに気づいた時と、お名前を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the medical staff about your symptoms. Please tell me when you noticed the hearing difficulty and your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝気づきました。私の名前はこちらです。友人が書いた紙には友人の名前が入っているので、患者は私だと訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 聞こえにくさは今朝気づいたと答えて自分の名前を示し、友人が書いた問診票の患者名を自分の名前に訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed it this morning. Here's my name. My friend put their own name on the paper they filled in, so I'd like to correct that: I'm the patient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you noticed the hearing difficulty this morning, give your name, and ask to correct the patient name on your friend's completed questionnaire to yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 患者さん本人の情報で受付しましょう。説明はご本人にも確認します。どのような伝え方がわかりやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's register using the patient's own information. We'll confirm explanations with you too. What way of communicating is easiest to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左側からゆっくり話してもらえると聞きやすいです。わからない時は、友人だけで返事せず、私にも確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左側からゆっくり話すと聞きやすく、わからない時も友人だけに返事を求めず自分に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's easier to hear if people speak slowly from my left side. When I don't understand, I'd like them to check with me too rather than have only my friend answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say slow speech from your left is easier to hear, and ask staff to check with you rather than seek replies only from your friend when something is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を担当に伝えます。使っている薬や、今回の症状について書いたメモはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass that request on. Do you have notes about medication you use or these symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お薬手帳があります。耳の症状は今朝からと書きました。持参した資料と問診票の名前を一致させたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: お薬手帳と今朝からの耳の症状を書いたメモを持参したので、資料と問診票の患者名を一致させたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my medication record book. I've written that the ear symptoms started this morning. I'd like the names on my documents and questionnaire to match.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought your medication record book and a note about this morning's ear symptoms, and want the patient names on your documents and questionnaire to match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 問診票の患者名を、お薬手帳のお名前と一致するよう訂正しました。こちらを左側からお見せします。友人の名前が患者欄に残っていないか、ご本人が確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've corrected the questionnaire's patient name to match your medication record book. I'll show it to you from your left. Can you check yourself that your friend's name is no longer in the patient field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、患者欄は私の名前で、手帳と一致しています。右耳の聞こえにくさに今朝気づいたことも合っています。医療担当にも左側からゆっくり話してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正後の患者名が自分のお薬手帳と一致すると確認し、今朝気づいた右耳の症状と左側からのゆっくりした説明希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the patient field has my name and matches the record book. It's also correct that I noticed the right-ear hearing difficulty this morning. I'd like the medical staff to speak slowly from my left too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected patient name matches your medication book, and state this morning's right-ear symptoms and your request for slow explanations from the left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。医療スタッフへおつなぎします。友人の方と案内した場所でお待ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Noted. I'll put you in touch with medical staff. Please wait with your friend where we've directed you. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。拾得物について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about found property?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 交通のカードを拾いました。使えるか試さずに届けたいです。施設の係の人に一度見せました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交通カードを拾って施設の係員に一度見せたと説明し、利用を試さずに届けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a transit card. I'd like to hand it in without testing whether it works. I showed it once to a facility staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you found a transit card and showed it to facility staff once, and want to hand it in without trying to use it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードは今お持ちですか。係の方には、預けたのか、見せただけなのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the card now? Please tell me whether you handed it to the staff member for keeping or only showed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一度預けましたが、こちらへ届けるよう言われて返されました。カードは今、この封筒に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 係員に一度預けたがこちらへ届けるよう返されたので、カードは今封筒に入れて持っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did hand it over once, but they returned it and told me to bring it here. The card is now in this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that staff returned the card after you handed it over and told you to bring it here, and you now have it in an envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拾った場所と時刻を確認します。拾った時から状態が変わった点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check where and when you found it. Has anything changed in its condition since then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売場の出口付近で昼ごろです。裸のカードを拾い、係の人が封筒に入れました。封筒は元からついていた物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昼ごろ売場の出口付近でカードだけを拾い、係員が後から封筒に入れたので封筒は拾得時の物ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Near the section's exit around noon. I found the card loose, and the staff member put it in an envelope. The envelope wasn't with it originally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you found only the card near the section exit around noon and staff later added the envelope, which was not part of the found item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経緯も記録します。カードの表示から読み取れる情報は、こちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record that sequence too. We'll check the information readable on the card here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前らしい文字がありますが、自分で持ち主を探すために写真を公開していません。届け先で確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードに名前らしい文字はあるが写真を公開して持ち主を探しておらず、届け先で確認してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are letters that look like a name, but I haven't published a photo to find the owner myself. I'd like the place handling the report to check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the card has what looks like a name, but you have not posted photos to search for the owner and want the receiving office to verify it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご自身の連絡先と、届け出の確認事項を伺います。拾得物に関するご意向も説明してから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I'll ask for your own contact details and the reporting information. We'll explain and then confirm your wishes concerning the found property too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 拾った場所、昼ごろという時刻、係の人へ預けて返されたことを伝えます。封筒は後から付けたものと記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 拾った場所と昼ごろの時刻、係員に預けて返された経緯を伝え、封筒は後から付けた物として記録してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the place, the time around noon, and handing it to staff and getting it back. Please record that the envelope was added afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the finding place, approximate noon time, and the handover-and-return sequence, and ask for the envelope to be recorded as added later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。カードの状態と経緯を確認してお預かりします。お届けいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the card's condition and history and accept it. Thank you for handing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。転居のお手続きで、何を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の寮から引っ越します。旧住所の欄に会社名だけ書いたのですが、これで転送できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の寮から引っ越すため、旧住所欄に会社名だけを書いても郵便を転送できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm moving out of company housing. I wrote only the company name in the old-address field. Will that allow my mail to be forwarded?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether entering only the company name as the old address allows mail forwarding when moving out of company housing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 旧住所は、これまで郵便を受け取っていた住所を確認してご記入ください。寮の建物名や部屋番号はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the old address, please check and enter the address where you received mail until now. Do you know the housing building name and room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ会社の寮が二つあります。私が住んでいたのは東棟の二〇三号室です。会社名だけでは場所がわかりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社の寮が二つあり自分が住んでいたのは東棟の部屋なので、会社名だけでは居住場所を区別できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The company has two housing buildings. I lived in room 203 of the east building. The company name alone doesn't identify the place, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the company has two housing buildings and you lived in the east building, so the company name alone does not distinguish your residence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 棟と部屋まで区別しましょう。新住所では、すでに郵便を受け取れる状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish the building and room. Are you already able to receive mail at the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入居は来週です。今週はまだ寮にいるので、転送を始めたい日も入居後にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新居への入居は来週で今週は寮にいるので、転送開始の希望日も入居後にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I move in next week. I'm still in company housing this week, so I'd also like the requested forwarding start date to be after moving in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you move into the new home next week and remain in housing this week, so you want forwarding to start after move-in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望日の指定と反映の扱いを案内で確認してください。会社や差出人への登録住所変更は、別途必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the instructions on specifying your preferred date and when it takes effect. Changes to the address registered with your company or other senders are needed separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 寮の担当にも退寮日を知らせます。転居届を出せば会社の給与書類の住所も変わると思っていましたが、別に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 寮の担当に退寮日を知らせると伝え、転居届で給与書類の登録住所も変わると思っていたが会社へ別途連絡すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell the housing staff my move-out date too. I thought a change-of-address notification would also change my address on the company's salary documents, but I'll contact the company separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will inform housing staff of move-out, and explain you thought the notification also updated salary-document registration but will contact the company separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。旧住所と新住所の記入、転送の希望、勤務先への連絡をそれぞれ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check your old and new address entries, forwarding request, and contact with your employer separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 旧住所に東棟と部屋番号を加え、入居後の希望日を確かめます。会社の住所登録も自分で変更を依頼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧住所に東棟と部屋番号を加え、入居後の転送希望日の扱いを確認し、会社の登録住所も自分で変更依頼すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll add the east building and room number to the old address and check the requested date after move-in. I'll also ask the company myself to change my registered address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will add the east building and room number to the old address, check the requested forwarding date after move-in, and ask the company yourself to update its registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入を確認し、受付方法をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check your entries and explain how to submit. Thank you for your inquiry.
